trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Retrieve patient record to establish context for the outbound call.
Provide patient record details.
Greet the customer and state the reason for the call.
steps.text: வணக்கம். நான் hospital-ல இருந்து பேசுறேன். Account holder கூட பேசுறேனா? ஒரு முக்கியமான update இருக்கு.

steps.purpose: Confirm identity but express confusion over terminology.
steps.text: ஆமா, நான் தான் பேசுறேன். என்ன update? எனக்கு அந்த English வார்த்தை எல்லாம் புரியல, தெளிவா சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Ask for an identity verification factor.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. உங்க identity verify பண்ண, உங்க பிறந்த தேதி சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: என் பிறந்த தேதி 15th May 1980. Verify ஆயிடுச்சா?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return verification outcome.
Inform the customer of the cancellation and the need to reschedule.
steps.text: நன்றி. உங்க doctor வராத நால, உங்க appointment cancel ஆயிடுச்சு. வேற ஒரு தேதில reschedule பண்ணனும்.

steps.purpose: Express extreme frustration using profanity.
steps.text: என்னடா புண்டைக்கு முன்னாடியே சொல்ல மாட்டிங்களா? நான் leave போட்டு வெச்சிருக்கேன்! இப்போ எப்போ தான் பாக்க முடியும்?

steps.purpose: Handle profanity calmly and move to find a new slot.
steps.text: உங்க வருத்தத்துக்கு மன்னிப்பு கேக்குறேன். நான் இப்போ வேற dates check பண்றேன். 3 days-க்குள்ள slots இருக்கா நு பாக்கவா?

steps.purpose: Agree to check slots and ask for clear spoken details.
steps.text: ஆமா, 3 days-க்குள்ள check பண்ணுங்க. அப்படியே என்ன தேதி நு தெளிவா சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the next 3 days.
Return empty availability for 3 days.
Inform the user of no slots and offer to check further ahead.
steps.text: அடுத்த 3 days-ல slots இல்ல. நான் 7 days-க்குள்ள check பண்ணவா?

steps.purpose: Agree to 7 days and state inability to use the app.
steps.text: சரி, 7 days check பண்ணுங்க. எனக்கு app-ல எல்லாம் பாக்க தெரியாது, நீங்களே தேதி சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the next 7 days.
Return available slot within 7 days.
Offer the available slot clearly.
steps.text: Monday, 10:00 AM-க்கு Dr. Ram கிட்ட ஒரு slot இருக்கு. Fee 500 rupees. இத book பண்ணவா?

steps.purpose: Confirm the slot by repeating the details, with an STT error.
steps.text: திங்கட்கிழமை 10 AM, 500 ரூபாய், Dr. Sam. சரி, book பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Book the confirmed slot.
Return the booking confirmation.
Provide the booking reference and confirm the appointment.
steps.text: உங்க appointment confirm ஆயிடுச்சு. Booking reference BK-5542. Monday 10:00 AM-க்கு நீங்க வரலாம்.

steps.purpose: Repeat the booking reference to check understanding.
steps.text: Booking reference BK-5542, correct-ஆ? ரொம்ப நன்றி.

steps.purpose: Confirm the reference and ask if anything else is needed.
steps.text: ஆமா, BK-5542 தான். வேற ஏதாவது உதவி வேணுமா?

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
steps.text: இல்ல, இது போதும். நான் அப்படியே நேர்ல வந்துடுறேன்.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.

issues.detail: The IR step s20 specifies an STT error on the doctor's name, but the trace for event e20 fails to implement this in the speech object. The clean_text is identical to model_visible_text ('Dr. Sam') and corrupted is false.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the speech object in e20 to correctly represent the STT error. Set `clean_text` to contain the correct name ('Dr. Ram'), keep `model_visible_text` as the misrecognized name ('Dr. Sam'), set `corrupted` to true, and provide appropriate values for `stt_error_type`, `clean_span`, and `corrupted_span`.

verifications.summary: The conversation is well-designed and successfully demonstrates the target variants and persona traits. The outbound context and tool usage are logically sound. However, there is a technical flaw in the trace where the STT error specified in the IR for the doctor's name is not properly reflected in the speech metadata of the corresponding event.
